name: Workflow
description: A state machine on the instance: a status that starts in the initial state and changes only through transition, along a transition the config lists. A transition may name a permission the caller must hold. A state that no transition leaves is terminal, and a terminal state has an outcome: success, failure or neutral, success unless the config says otherwise. Other instances' blockers, rollups and reactions read it.

initial.description: The state a new instance starts in; the first of states when absent.

outcomes.description: The outcome of each terminal state it names: success, failure or neutral. A terminal state it does not name is a success. Each key is a terminal state of states.

states.description: Every state an instance can be in.

transitions.description: The moves the status may make. A state that no transition leaves is terminal.

from.description: The state the instance is in.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to make this transition. Absent, any caller who may write the instance can.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

operations.name: transition
operations.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the instance was in.

to.description: The state it is in now.

vetoes.description: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
No transition of the config leads from the instance's state to the one named.
The instance has no status to move from.
